# Khaidir Syafei — Muslim Children’s Book Illustrator

> Khaidir Syafei is a children’s book illustrator and visual designer who illustrates Islamic and Muslim children’s books for authors, self-publishers, and Muslim publishers. All illustrations are created by the artist, without AI.

## Services
- Children’s book illustration (cover and interior pages)
- Character design and personalized book characters
- Visual design for Muslim-owned brands

## Selected projects
- Iam! affirmation for little Muslim — written by Umm Laith, published by Proud Little Muslims, 26 pages
- My Feelings are like a balloon — written by Zahie El Hajj, published by Little Hibba, 28 pages
- Zayd's Journey to Zakat — written by Umm Inaayah, published by Fitrah Beginnings, 40 pages
- I WANT TO BE LIKE.. The Ten Promised Paradise — written by Umm Inaayah, published by Fitrah Beginnings, 26 pages
- My Mama's Hijab — written by Sana Vawda, published by Little Hibba, 26 pages
- Inventors of the Golden Age: Just Like.. — written by Umm Laith, published by Proud Little Muslims, 32 pages

## FAQ
- Does he use AI to create illustrations? No. Every illustration is created by the artist, without AI.
- What is needed to start? A manuscript or story outline, page count, reader age, style references, and a deadline.
- How much does it cost? It depends on page count, style, and usage rights; a quote is given after reviewing the manuscript.
- Who has he worked with? Authors and Muslim publishers including Proud Little Muslims, Little Hibba, and Fitrah Beginnings.
